title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Yamanin Zephyr…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her gaze is fixed on a claw machine filled with Umamusume plushies.
choice_data_list: Are you talking about those plushies?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. The glass is keeping them from feeling the wind…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If only I could free them, and let them bathe in the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I don't have much experience with claw machines, though, so I imagine any efforts I make will prove fruitless.
choice_data_list: I'll get you one if you want.
I'll get you one if you want.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? That would be wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
